# Mission: fully playable, high-fidelity Richman4

Recreate the targeted original Richman4 for the owner's private play: original rules, content, controls, pace and presentation, with modern implementation. Target 90–95% player-perceived fidelity and a complete game. This is not a generic board-game platform; the percentage is a target, not a measured score.

## Authority

This issue owns product goals and release acceptance. [#204](https://github.com/nurockplayer/richman4-remake/issues/204) owns native playtest/repair; [#52](https://github.com/nurockplayer/richman4-remake/issues/52) is the current handoff; [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nurockplayer/richman4-remake/blob/main/AGENTS.md) owns engineering workflow and Astra leadership. [#99](https://github.com/nurockplayer/richman4-remake/issues/99) details fidelity evidence. Child issues retain specific contracts. Comments and superseded process issues are historical, not live status.

## Product and safety boundaries

- Deliver a standalone Godot desktop game, first on Apple Silicon macOS, retaining Windows/Linux portability. The delivered game must not require a browser or development environment.
- Match the pinned original edition. Preserve known original behavior; make only necessary, documented deviations when reliable reproduction, ordinary play or hard constraints require them. Bound low-impact unknowns and reasonable fallbacks; whole missing screens or systems are not minor deviations.
- Keep simulation/RNG reproducible and save/load reliable. Protect owner saves and isolate tests. Unreleased development saves need not acquire permanent gameplay compatibility: use proportionate migration or clear incompatibility without silent data loss.
- Decouple texture pixels, logical layout/input and physical display resolution. Higher-resolution assets must not require gameplay/save rewrites. Derive dimensions from evidence rather than guesses.
- Secrets and original assets/captures without publication rights stay out of the public code repo. Canonical assets remain private `nurockplayer/richman4-remake-assets` + Git LFS, retrieved and verified through the pinned manifest/bootstrap.
- Source-of-truth/runtime migration, Hot Reload/cutover and unapproved Tachiko M5 remain outside this mission. Public release/distribution requires separate rights/owner authorization.

Astra may revise sequencing, architecture and implementation methods when evidence improves correctness and delivery. Keep Godot for current delivery; an engine rewrite has no demonstrated justification. Engineering process lives in AGENTS.md rather than duplicated policy here.

## Completion criteria — still open

- [ ] The exact final packaged app launches on Apple Silicon macOS without a checkout and reaches the intended real catalog/content through normal title/new-game setup.
- [ ] A human can play with AI through a complete match, settlement and restart, using ordinary native input without developer intervention; normal quit works.
- [ ] Core systems and required screens/flows are reachable and usable, including finance, properties, cards/tools/shop, events, inventory and saves. No unresolved blocking ordinary-play defects remain.
- [ ] Real disk save and fresh-process load preserve the game and deterministic continuation; errors/cancellations are safe and recoverable.
- [ ] The full required screen/flow coverage has same-edition original/remake comparisons, necessary interactions and independent visual acceptance under #99. A debug/dashboard shell or fixture-only success does not qualify.
- [ ] Fresh checkout/bootstrap, tests and private packaging are reproducible for the owner. Final source, executable/package, catalog and asset identities accompany the evidence.
- [ ] Functional, native/package and original-presentation verdicts are separately recorded for the integrated candidate, deferred minor gaps are explicit, and the owner/Steward accepts mission closure.

Historical #89 and later receipts retain their original validity; checked historical baselines are not current acceptance. Child merges do not close this mission.

Governance revised at the owner's request on 2026-10-14. [Audit and preserved prior bodies](https://github.com/nurockplayer/richman4-remake/blob/main/docs/governance/2026-10-14-audit.md).
bodies.204:
# Full native playtest-and-repair mission

Drive Richman4 from normal native launch through a complete, repeatable human/AI game and the required high-fidelity screens. This is the active P0 execution mission under [#1](https://github.com/nurockplayer/richman4-remake/issues/1). Astra chooses engineering work and continues autonomously under [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nurockplayer/richman4-remake/blob/main/AGENTS.md); [#52](https://github.com/nurockplayer/richman4-remake/issues/52) records current source, ownership and next action.

## Work and priorities

Play, observe, reproduce, repair and verify. Prioritize crashes, dead controls, soft locks, broken turns and major gameplay errors, then complete required fidelity coverage. Use existing issues and research; do not wait for the owner to report every missing screen. Refactor when evidence justifies it. No historical S-stage order, mandatory session reset, worker wrapper or source-recovery-only admission controls this mission.

Choose and record an available source baseline. Unavailable `f585addddaee7dca69aa3f60c192bff779c62ac8` remains historical evidence, not a prerequisite for new work. Main/PR205 are not equivalent to it and do not inherit its PASS. Reproduce relevant known defects on the selected baseline. Preserve historical drafts, unapplied proposals and utility patches; adopt their logical changes only after assessing current relevance and validation.

## Native acceptance coverage

| Journey | Required observable result |
| --- | --- |
| Launch/title/setup | Real catalog and human character/map/options selection reach a valid human turn. |
| Dice/movement/route/landing | Visible input works; movement and route selection lead to purchase/upgrade/cancel or another legal mandatory response and continuation. |
| Turns | AI takes its turns and control returns to the human repeatedly without developer intervention. |
| Finance | Bank/ATM/keypad, loans and stock selection/buy/sell/cancel/close/reopen are usable; displayed funds and holdings agree with transaction effects. |
| Inventory | Legal card/tool/shop actions, targeting/reactions and cancel/close work; no stale overlay captures input. |
| Events and surfaces | News/fate/lottery/calendar/help/settings and other required surfaces resolve or dismiss and return to play. |
| Persistence | Actual UI disk SAVE, process exit, fresh-process title LOAD and continued play preserve the game; failed load/cancel is recoverable. |
| Complete game | Longer ordinary play reaches endgame/settlement, restart and normal quit. Audio and all required presentation coverage receive explicit verdicts. |

Use isolated profiles and preserve owner saves. Record exact source/runtime/catalog identity, visible actions, expected/actual results and evidence. Mark each covered boundary PASS, FAIL or NOT RUN with its reason. Source/headless/fixture tests support diagnosis but cannot prove native ordinary reachability. An OS-injected event counts only when the actual player-visible response is observed; direct handler calls do not.

The [stock and research worksheet](https://github.com/nurockplayer/richman4-remake/issues/204#issuecomment-6018731339) preserves useful oracles: separate zero/Escape/outside-click stock cancellations, independent buy/sell amounts and ledgers, return-to-turn continuity, and real save/load research timing. Recheck prerequisites on the current candidate. Its old executor restrictions and preparation review are not new admission requirements or behavioral PASS.

## Repair and close gate

Preserve minimal reproductions, apply the appropriate focused/affected/native checks, and get independent nonauthor review plus applicable hosted checks on the final candidate before merge. Carry valid unresolved P1/P2 debt forward. Record material decisions and results here or in the owning PR, and keep #52 concise. Continue across merges while safe authorized work remains; genuine external blockers must name the missing capability and allow unblocked work to continue.

Close this issue only with fresh integrated packaged/native evidence for the journey above, no unresolved blocking gameplay defects, a disposition for every discovered material finding, and explicit nonblocking fidelity debt. Full fidelity and mission closure still require #1/#99 evidence and owner/Steward acceptance. No public release or asset publication is authorized.

Revised 2026-10-14: [audit and preserved history](https://github.com/nurockplayer/richman4-remake/blob/main/docs/governance/2026-10-14-audit.md).

# Original-presentation acceptance

The owner rejected the main-board and stock presentation on 2026-09-10. This remains a high-fidelity acceptance failure; historical functional/package success does not close it. #1 defines the product and final acceptance, #204 owns delivery, AGENTS.md owns workflow, and #52 records live state. Older routing, fixed first-slice order and polling/deadline instructions are superseded by the [2026-10-14 audit](https://github.com/nurockplayer/richman4-remake/blob/main/docs/governance/2026-10-14-audit.md).

## Coverage and references

Cover every required player-facing screen and flow of the targeted original version, not only owner-reported screenshots. Keep Game and MultiverseJourney provenance distinct. Use the compact coverage matrix under #102, existing manual/source research and authorized original observations; familiarity is not exact reference evidence.

At minimum cover title/new game; character/map/options; board/HUD before and after movement; stock overview/selection/trades; purchase/upgrades; bank/ATM/loans; cards/tools/shop/targeting/reactions; news/fate/lottery; help/calendar/options; save/load; settlement/restart. Include distinct menus, overlays, confirmations and temporary event states. A missing screen is a gap; every number or sprite frame need not be a separate case.

Record original edition/provenance, comparable state/actions, expected information, dimensions, remake entry/capability, comparison evidence, permitted deviations and independent verdict. Keep restricted images private. Bound minor unknowns under #1; do not invent dimensions, company data, charts or timings.

## Product acceptance

- Ordinary launch/new game reaches the intended original catalog and an original-oriented flow/board/HUD. Debug logs, internal IDs, fallback controls and the rejected dashboard shell are not default product presentation.
- Compare framing/scale, information hierarchy, portraits/icons and usable interactions against the same-edition reference. A static screenshot overlay or nonfunctional skin fails.
- Stocks expose original companies, source-backed information and usable controls. Recoloring the three-symbol fallback is insufficient. #100's provenance diagnosis remains evidence: the owner's valid v4 development save selected that legacy path; source implementation alone did not prove correct installed entry.
- Opening/closing/selecting must not unexpectedly mutate simulation or consume RNG; trade/cancel/error effects obey domain contracts and retained safety regressions.

## Evidence and close gate

Keep functional, native/package and original-presentation verdicts separate. For each accepted screen provide original/remake comparison and necessary native interaction evidence, exact source/build/catalog identity, reproducible setup, result and explicit deviations, with independent visual review tied to those artifacts. Screenshots merely existing or self-approved baselines do not pass; labeled fixtures cannot replace normal entry.

Before #1 closes, no required screen/flow may remain unaccepted, and the owner/Steward must accept the integrated rendered evidence. An owner-approved scope exception stays visible; never relabel it as restored. Do not claim a measured 90–95% score without a defined measurement.

Original rejected baseline, prior hypotheses and receipts remain in [the archive](https://github.com/nurockplayer/richman4-remake/blob/main/docs/governance/archive/2026-10-14/issue-99.md), #89/#100 and the original comments. Preserve their candidate-specific limits.

# Native playability findings and regression record

This issue preserves the owner's 2026-09-12 functional findings and their reproduction history. [#204](https://github.com/nurockplayer/richman4-remake/issues/204) owns the full native playtest-and-repair mission; AGENTS.md owns engineering and writer/input coordination. The old QA captain, parallel-package plan and checkpoint schedule are superseded by the [2026-10-14 audit](https://github.com/nurockplayer/richman4-remake/blob/main/docs/governance/2026-10-14-audit.md).

Reproduce or explicitly disposition these observations on the actual current candidate:

- Human dice/roll fails to produce usable movement.
- Route choice shows raw/debug-like labels; assess both interaction and original presentation.
- Bank/ATM keypad clicks do not respond.
- Help displays unavailable content and cannot dismiss, soft-locking play.

Keep findings as: severity, exact source/build, entry/action, expected/source reference, actual result, reproducibility, evidence and owning repair issue/PR. Separate functional, native-input and fidelity verdicts. Deduplicate existing repairs; historical PASS covers only its recorded subject.

The audit record is complete when each area of #204's coverage has an actual PASS, reproducible owned finding or specific external blocker; all discovered P0/P1s are triaged; the four owner observations have exact-subject dispositions; and the remaining repair queue is actionable. This audit completion is not playable-game, fidelity or release acceptance. Restricted screenshots stay private.

[Exact prior body and coverage](https://github.com/nurockplayer/richman4-remake/blob/main/docs/governance/archive/2026-10-14/issue-167.md); existing comments remain historical evidence.
